errors.text: The FEP mechanism is formulated as exponential averaging between EAM and MTP states, whereas the intended substitution uses MTP sampling with perturbative corrections to the DFT target; EAM belongs to the baseline TI route.
The required 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell boundary is not specified and is replaced by an unrelated dislocation/slip-plane periodicity argument.

The hypothesis conflates solid-state SRO with the liquid-phase phase-space fidelity required from the MTP and even proposes measuring liquid SRO as the main validation of the solid stabilization contribution.
The cited evidence does not directly support the central claims about MTP-FEP accuracy, sub-meV convergence, electronic-excitation shifts, or TaVCrW SRO stabilization.
